title: Mateo Weather Network (Reference Blueprint)
tagline: Community weather station blueprint for cities, farms, and off-grid valleys.
summary: An open-source, solar-powered weather station blueprint designed to bring reliable local microclimate measurements to areas commercial stations miss (reference specification only).
whatItSolves: Official weather stations cost thousands of dollars, while cheap backyard sensors skew readings in direct sunlight. The Mateo blueprint pairs solar hardware with multi-stage neighbor sanity checking.
highlights: Three reference topologies for balconies, rural farms, and off-grid villages
Three-stage Zero Trust telemetry quality checks filter sun-glare spikes
Maintained strictly as a hardware/architecture reference design

detailPage.headline: Local weather station architecture, documented openly.
paragraphs: Official weather stations cost thousands of dollars and sit near airports—leaving farms, valleys, and small towns without accurate local frost or rain signals.
Mateo is maintained as an open hardware reference blueprint for solar-powered environmental nodes.

topologiesSection.title: Three station setups across environments.
topologiesSection.subtitle: The blueprint pairs a shared Bosch BME280 + air-quality core with three power and radio options.

items.title: Home Wi-Fi Station
items.subtitle: For apartments, rooftops, and neighborhoods
items.description: Deep-sleep duty cycling wakes the microcontroller briefly every few minutes to transmit encrypted readings and preserve winter solar battery life.

items.title: Long-Range LoRa Mast + Indoor Hub
items.subtitle: When the sensor sits beyond Wi-Fi range
items.description: Streams readings up to 2 km over SX1262 LoRa to an indoor OLED receiver that continues logging locally to microSD even during internet outages.

items.title: Solar Community Kiosk
items.subtitle: Local access without cellular infrastructure
items.description: Relay nodes forward frost and rainfall telemetry to a local offline kiosk portal accessible on community Wi-Fi.

stepsSection.title: Three automatic data sanity checks.
stepsSection.subtitle: Before accepting readings, the reference pipeline isolates physical wire faults and solar radiation bias.

steps.title: Physical bounds filtering
steps.description: Out-of-range spikes from loose wires are discarded before persistence.

steps.title: Rate-of-change spike detection
steps.description: Impossible 5°C jumps in under a minute from direct sun glare are flagged automatically.

steps.title: Neighbor cross-validation
steps.description: Each station is cross-checked against peers within 25 km to compute a rolling quality index.
